Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
# set of number and sum is given
# -1,1,0,0,-2,2

# sum = 0
# print no. of combination possible of lenght 4
# which sum = 0

from itertools import combinations
num = list(map(int,input().split(',')))
s = int(input())
com = list(combinations(num,4))

count = 0
for i in com:
    i = sum(i)
    if(i == s):
        count+=1
print(count)
